name: wiki
description: Wiki documentation system — fragment-linked documentation with change detection, full-text search, and automated maintenance

capabilities: Validates wiki pages after every file edit, surfacing residual diagnostics inline
Auto-fixes frontmatter, fragment-link, and citation drift via the wiki check --fix flow
Keeps fragment-linked documentation from silently drifting as code changes
defaultPrompt: Run a wiki check across my edits, fix what it reports, and explain any drift it found.
